description: At session end, write the one-file session baton (docs/session/baton.md): a high-level summary of what this session was about, the goal, and the single next task. Overwrites the file — no change lists, no task lists, no detail. Read-only on git; writes only the baton. Use `session-wrapup` for git state and progress.md.
